title: badf init: require a reviewed published WP allocation before intake
problem:
## Measured defect and bounded proposal

At BADF `b9936e591530a74f919a86c80934b575c3a231e3`, `scripts/badf_gate.py:next_wp_id()` scans only local landed `work/` directories. It returns WP-2026-0160, already occupied by remote branch `wp/WP-2026-0160-mas-std-gap-analysis` / open PR #364 (head `50459d2634de8b87837186d59f80c4cb95e26126`). Intake also writes target files before permissively creating the WP directory.

This blocks governed BizTrust intake: https://github.com/bstBizEra/biztrust_ib/issues/71. Bera's decision there authorizes BADF-DEM-0146 for BizTrust only at the existing framework pin. It does not authorize this upstream implementation.

## Outcome and scope

Make intake require an explicit, published, independently reconciled allocation before any target mutation. Proposed interface:

`badf init <intent> --work-package WP-2026-NNNN --allocation <record.json>`

Both arguments are required; no silent landed-only max+1 fallback. Update CLI callers, documentation, contracts/schemas and tests together.

Scope: intake allocation evidence, offline validation using existing sweep logic, shared-checkout concurrency, bounded failure recovery, docs/callers/tests. Anticipated change class C3 because gate/controller code is affected; final classification follows existing routing.

Out of scope: runtime/release/deployment/product status, G00 approval, global allocation service, new network dependencies, placeholder ledger entries, monkeypatches, merging unrelated work, and the separately measured demand-status enforcement gap.

## Allocation evidence contract

Bind exact WP ID, framework repository/revision and executed controller/schema identities, target repository/baseline, demand ID/file digest, claimant, published claim URL/comment identity/author/timestamps/retained content digest, retained API acquisition evidence, sweep input/report digests and completeness/capture observations, common checkout/worktree inventory, active-seat identities and explicit unpublished/unpushed claim disclosures, independent reviewer/reconciliation decision and exact reviewed digest, and non-coverage.

Caller JSON or matching hashes establish neither GitHub identity nor global exclusivity. Retain source evidence and independent channel verification. Published issue claims remain the binding mechanism; independent clones remain invisible.

Require readable nonblank ledger, branches, PR file lists, bodies and comments; complete successful pagination/gathering, known-present positive controls and prescribed sentinel exclusions. Recompute claim-shaped occupancy using existing sweep semantics. Prose remains a mention requiring explicit reconciliation, not a regex-derived allocation. Refuse missing, ambiguous, forged, rejected/superseded or conflicting allocation evidence.

Bind freshness to reviewed framework/controller/schema, demand, target HEAD/status/AGENTS, claim and acquired sweep evidence. Re-sweep/reconcile affected drift; do not invent an arbitrary expiry interval.

## Concurrency, mutation and recovery

Use the verified Git common directory for clone-wide reservation/locking across sibling worktrees. Serialize both WP reservation and target/project/registry uniqueness, so two different IDs cannot register the same target or overwrite shared metadata. Define deterministic lock order.

Prepare and schema-validate all generated outputs before writes. Inside the locks, reread and revalidate target baseline/cleanliness/AGENTS, absence of instance, project/registry uniqueness, framework/controller/schema, demand and allocation evidence before first target mutation.

Reject existing WP paths, symlinks and partial/foreign reservations. Retain allocation evidence and bind its digest in the WP and init receipt. Preserve existing AGENTS behavior and unsigned HUMAN_REQUIRED G00.

On partial failure, retain diagnostic receipt and held reservation. Never recursively delete a namespace after ownership or expected bytes drift. Recovery must be a named bounded action with exact ownership/content checks; never blindly retry.

## Acceptance and meaningful negative tests

- Occupied remote branch/PR/competing claim refuses despite a lower landed maximum.
- Explicit allocation is consistent across WP, target state, registry, receipt and dossier.
- Missing/blank/undecodable/truncated or incomplete gathers, missing anchors/disclosures, harmless prose versus competing claim, malformed/sentinel/traversal IDs, wrong bindings, forged attribution and edited/stale evidence are covered.
- Same-ID contenders in one clone/sibling worktrees and different-ID/same-target contenders cannot both succeed; registry writes are coordinated.
- Inject preflight-to-write drift and partial failures; conservative recovery preserves evidence and foreign changes.
- Every preflight refusal leaves protected target, existing WP, registry and lockfile bytes unchanged.
- Positive case preserves existing AGENTS and unsigned G00 hold.
- Independent review and composed-result targeted tests, repository gate and mandatory full suite must run before implementation acceptance.

## Separate observed finding

Intake calls load_demand(), which checks human-shaped authorized_by for issue records but does not require status AUTHORIZED. Track that independently; do not silently expand this allocator package.

## Governed route

Freeze source; repeat full sweep and active-seat disclosures; publish reconciled demand/WP claims before binding IDs; export exact demand; obtain human authorization and approved implementation WP; implement/review/test under existing controls; land approved candidate; explicitly reconcile its new BADF revision with BizTrust authorization; then freshly allocate BizTrust intake and generate its own G00 request.

Discovery/preparation is allowed by the existing demand doctrine. This proposal supplies no human authorization, approved implementation WP, G07 PASS, merge authority or gate approval.

## Independent preparation review

Design author: /root/allocator_correction_design. Independent read-only challenge: /root/allocator_independent_review. Both disclosed zero unpublished/unpushed ID claims. Review disposition APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS for proposal preparation only; the common-directory/target concurrency, integrity-versus-authenticity, locked rechecks, conservative recovery and complete CLI update conditions are incorporated above.

Baseline source/doctrine inspection performed. Implementation/code review/new tests/repository gate/full suite for this proposed change: NOT_RUN. No implementation artifact exists. No demand/WP ID is bound in this source body; the subsequent allocation and export packet will hold those identities.

Disposition: bounded correction proposal prepared; upstream implementation HUMAN_REQUIRED under its own exact demand and approved WP.
